logic.direction: ETH leads BTC; buy only the follower, no short or simultaneous holdings.
logic.signal: At each UTC hour boundary m, use only fully closed 1-minute bars through m-1. For fixed lookback L in {15,60,240} minutes, compute simple BTC and ETH returns from close[m-1-L] to close[m-1]. For direction leader->follower, signal when leader_return is strictly greater than 0.5% and leader_return - follower_return is strictly greater than 0.25 percentage points. If flat, buy only the follower at the m+1 one-minute open (60-second signal availability delay), using all available USDT subject to frozen fee, spread, slippage, lagged impact and exchange filters. Hold for H in {60,240,720} minutes, then liquidate at the first hourly decision boundary at/after expiry plus one minute; if exit is rejected, retain actual cash/units and retry at later hourly boundaries. Do not enter while holding, do not backfill missed boundaries, and do not open a trade whose scheduled expiry is beyond the terminal boundary. Force-cost any remaining units at 2026-09-14 00:01 UTC. Isolated $2,000 account per configuration, spot long-only, no scaling, leverage, transfer, yield, or cross-configuration rebalancing.
logic.limitations: Historical Binance 1m OHLCV tests a fixed cross-asset lead-lag rule; no orderbook or actual exchange fills; repeated history; no untouched final holdout.

sources.citation: Sifat, I. M., Mohamad, A., & Mohamed Shariff, M. S. B. (2019). Lead-lag relationship between Bitcoin and Ethereum: Evidence from hourly and daily data. Research in International Business and Finance, 50, 306-321. DOI:10.1016/j.ribaf.2019.06.012.
sources.finding_summary: The authors report largely bidirectional price discovery from 2017-2018 hourly/daily BTC and ETH data and state that intraday traders could barely exploit it. This motivates a cost-first BTC/ETH follower test; their older sample does not establish a current trading edge.

failure_gates.interpretation: Historical development/validation sample only; not an untouched holdout or live profitability guarantee.
